name: Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich
steps: Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper and a pinch of paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a pan on medium-high and cook the chicken 5-6 minutes per side until fully cooked through (internal temp 75°C). Rest 3 minutes, then slice.
Toast the bread lightly. Spread light mayonnaise on both slices.
Layer lettuce, tomato and sliced chicken. Close the sandwich, cut diagonally and serve.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
steps: Boil 2 whole eggs and 3 extra egg whites for 9-10 minutes. Cool in cold water, peel.
Chop the eggs/whites finely and mix with light mayonnaise and chopped onion.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spread the egg mixture over one slice of bread, top with lettuce, close with the second slice.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Sandwich
steps: In a small bowl, mix the peanut butter with the whey protein powder and 1 tsp water until it forms a smooth, spreadable protein-PB paste.
Spread the protein-PB paste evenly on both slices of bread.
Layer banana slices on one side, drizzle honey over them.
Close the sandwich and press gently. Can be pan-toasted 2 minutes per side if you prefer it warm.

name: Paneer Tikka Sandwich
steps: Mix curd with red chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala and salt. Marinate the paneer cubes 10 minutes.
Pan-grill the marinated paneer with bell pepper and onion on medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly charred.
Spread light mayonnaise on the bread slices.
Layer the grilled paneer and vegetables, close the sandwich, and serve warm.

name: Tuna Sandwich
steps: Drain the tuna well and flake it with a fork in a bowl.
Mix in light mayonnaise, chopped onion and lemon juice. Season with black pepper.
Spread the tuna mixture on one slice of bread, top with lettuce, close with the second slice.

name: Hung Curd & Veggie Sandwich
steps: Mix hung curd with crumbled paneer, grated carrot and chopped mint. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the mixture generously on one slice of bread.
Top with diced cucumber and tomato, close the sandwich.

name: Chicken Mayo Sandwich
steps: Boil the chicken breast in salted water for 12-15 minutes until cooked through. Cool and shred with two forks.
Mix the shredded chicken with light mayonnaise, salt and cracked black pepper.
Layer lettuce on one slice of bread, top with the chicken mayo mixture, close with the second slice.

name: Sprouts & Paneer Sandwich
steps: Lightly steam the moong sprouts for 2 minutes, then cool.
Mix sprouts with crumbled paneer, chopped onion, tomato, crushed roasted chana and lemon juice. Season to taste.
Pile the mixture onto a slice of bread and close with the second slice, pressing gently.

name: Egg Bhurji Sandwich
steps: Heat ghee in a pan, sauté onion and green chilli for 2 minutes, then add tomato and cook until soft.
Beat the eggs and extra egg white together, pour into the pan and scramble on medium heat until just set.
Season with salt and turmeric. Spoon the bhurji onto a slice of bread and close with the second slice.

name: Soya Chunk Sandwich Spread
steps: Boil the soya chunks in water for 5 minutes until fully rehydrated and soft, then drain and squeeze out excess water.
Pulse the rehydrated soya chunks in a mixer 2-3 times until coarsely minced (do not puree).
Sauté garlic and onion for 2 minutes, add the minced soya and tomato, cook 4-5 minutes. Cool slightly, mix in light mayonnaise.
Spread onto bread and close the sandwich.

name: Chicken Tikka Roll
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, garam masala and salt for at least 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the marinated chicken with onion and bell pepper on high heat for 7-8 minutes until charred and cooked through.
Warm the tortilla wrap. Place the chicken tikka mixture and mint leaves in the centre.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Slice in half to serve.

name: Paneer Tikka Roll
steps: Marinate paneer cubes in curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder and garam masala for 10 minutes.
Pan-grill the marinated paneer with bell pepper and onion for 5-6 minutes until lightly charred.
Warm the tortilla wrap, place the paneer tikka and mint leaves in the centre, roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Egg Roll
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. Pour onto a hot lightly-oiled pan to make a thin omelette, cook 2 minutes each side.
Warm the tortilla wrap and place the omelette flat on it.
Top with onion, carrot, lettuce and a drizzle of light mayonnaise.
Roll tightly, tucking in the sides, and slice in half.

name: Soya Chaap-Style Roll
steps: Boil soya chunks 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain and squeeze out excess water thoroughly.
Marinate the rehydrated soya chunks in curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder and garam masala for 10 minutes.
Pan-grill the marinated soya with onion and bell pepper on high heat for 6-7 minutes until lightly charred at the edges.
Warm the tortilla wrap, fill with the soya mixture and mint leaves, roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Grilled Chicken Lettuce Wrap
steps: Season chicken slices with salt, pepper and a pinch of chilli flakes.
Grill or pan-cook the chicken on medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until fully cooked, then slice into strips.
Lay out 3-4 large lettuce leaves, add chicken strips, cucumber and carrot, drizzle with light mayonnaise.
Fold the lettuce leaves around the filling like a wrap and serve immediately.

name: Rajma-Paneer Wrap
steps: Lightly mash the boiled rajma with a fork, leaving some texture.
Mix in crumbled paneer, chopped onion, tomato and coriander. Season with chaat masala and salt.
Warm the tortilla wrap, spread the filling across the centre, roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Tofu Stir-fry Wrap
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté garlic for 30 seconds, then add tofu cubes and pan-fry until lightly golden on all sides (5-6 minutes).
Add bell pepper, carrot and onion, stir-fry on high heat for 3-4 minutes until just tender-crisp.
Season with soy sauce or salt and black pepper.
Warm the tortilla wrap, fill with the tofu stir-fry, roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Tandoori Chicken Wrap
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic paste and a squeeze of lemon for 20 minutes (longer if possible).
Pan-sear or grill the chicken on high heat for 7-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through.
Warm the tortilla wrap, layer lettuce, onion, the tandoori chicken and mint leaves.
Roll tightly and slice in half to serve.

name: Chickpea-Paneer Wrap
steps: Lightly mash half the chickpeas with a fork, keeping the rest whole for texture.
Mix chickpeas with crumbled paneer, onion, tomato and lemon juice. Season with cumin powder and salt.
Warm the tortilla wrap, fill with the mixture, roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Fish Tikka Roll

items.label: Basa or any firm white fish, cubed

steps: Marinate the fish cubes in curd, red chilli powder, ajwain and salt for 10 minutes (don't over-marinate delicate fish).
Pan-sear the fish gently on medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side until just cooked through (it flakes easily).
Warm the tortilla wrap, layer the fish tikka, onion, bell pepper and mint leaves.
Roll gently (fish is delicate) and slice in half.

name: High-Protein Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, biryani masala, ginger-garlic paste and salt for 20 minutes.
Heat ghee in a pan, fry onions until golden, remove half for garnish.
Add the marinated chicken and tomato to the pan, cook covered for 12-15 minutes until the chicken is done and the masala thickens.
Layer the cooked brown rice over the chicken masala, cover and steam on low heat for 5 minutes to let flavours combine.
Gently fold together, garnish with the reserved fried onion and serve hot.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat half the oil in a wok, scramble the eggs until just set, remove and set aside.
Add the remaining oil, sauté onion, carrot and bell pepper on high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return the scrambled egg to the wok, mix through, season with soy sauce and pepper, and serve hot.

name: Soya Chunk Pulao
steps: Boil soya chunks for 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain and squeeze out excess water.
Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft.
Add the rehydrated soya chunks and corn, along with pulao masala (cumin, garam masala, salt), cook 5-6 minutes.
Fold in the cooked brown rice gently, cover and heat through for 3-4 minutes before serving.

name: Paneer Pulao
steps: Lightly pan-fry the paneer cubes in a teaspoon of ghee until golden on the edges, set aside.
In the same pan, sauté onion, bell pepper and tomato for 4-5 minutes with pulao spices.
Fold in the cooked rice and the pan-fried paneer, cover and heat through for 3-4 minutes.
Fluff gently with a fork before serving.

name: Quinoa Chicken Pulao
steps: Heat olive oil, sauté onion until translucent, add tomato and cook until soft.
Add the chicken cubes with pulao spices (cumin, coriander powder, garam masala, salt), cook covered for 10-12 minutes until done.
Fold in the cooked quinoa, mix well and heat through for 2-3 minutes before serving.

name: Prawn Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a wok, sauté garlic for 30 seconds, add prawns and cook 2-3 minutes until pink and just cooked (don't overcook).
Remove prawns, add bell pepper and carrot to the wok, stir-fry 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice, stir-fry 3-4 minutes, then return the prawns to the wok.
Season with soy sauce and pepper, toss together and serve hot.

name: Chana Pulao
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft.
Add the boiled chickpeas with pulao spices (cumin, garam masala, salt), cook 5-6 minutes to let them absorb the flavour.
Fold in the cooked rice gently, cover and heat through for 3-4 minutes before serving.

name: Protein Moong Dal Khichdi with Paneer
steps: Heat ghee in a pan, sauté onion until golden.
Add the cooked moong dal and rice, along with turmeric, cumin and salt, mix well and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the crumbled paneer just before serving so it stays soft, and mix through gently.
Serve hot with an extra spoon of ghee on top if desired.

name: Chicken Keema Rice
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft.
Add the chicken mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, for 10-12 minutes until fully cooked and dry.
Stir in the boiled corn and pulao spices, cook 2 minutes more.
Fold in the cooked rice, mix well and heat through before serving.

name: Sprouts Pulao
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until translucent, add carrot and tomato, cook 3-4 minutes.
Add the sprouts and pulao spices, cook covered for 5-6 minutes until the sprouts are just tender.
Fold in the cooked rice, mix well and heat through for 2-3 minutes before serving.

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Heat ghee in a pan, sauté onion and green chilli for 2-3 minutes until translucent.
Add tomato and bell pepper, cook until softened, about 4-5 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder and salt, then crumble in the paneer.
Mix well and cook for 3-4 minutes until heated through. Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala (Light)
steps: Marinate paneer cubes in curd, red chilli powder and garam masala for 10 minutes, then pan-sear until lightly golden. Set aside.
Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add pureed tomato and cook until the raw smell disappears (6-8 minutes).
Add garam masala, kasuri methi and salt, simmer 2-3 minutes.
Add the seared paneer back in, simmer 3-4 minutes to absorb the gravy, and serve.

name: Soya Chunk Curry (Soya Keema Masala)
steps: Boil soya chunks for 5 minutes, drain and squeeze out excess water thoroughly, then pulse briefly in a mixer to a keema-like texture.
Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft and the oil separates.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala and salt, then add the soya keema.
Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, adding a splash of water if it looks dry. Serve hot.

name: Tofu Bhurji
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until translucent, add tomato and bell pepper, cook until softened.
Add turmeric, cumin powder and salt, then crumble in the tofu.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring gently, until heated through. Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: Paneer Chilla Stack
steps: Whisk besan with curd, turmeric, salt and enough water to make a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat a little oil on a flat pan, pour a ladle of batter and spread into a thin pancake. Cook 2 minutes per side until golden.
Meanwhile, mix crumbled paneer with chopped onion and tomato, season lightly.
Stack two chillas with the paneer filling in between, press gently, slice into wedges and serve.

name: Soya Chunk Stir-fry
steps: Boil soya chunks 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain and squeeze out excess water well.
Heat oil in a wok, sauté garlic 30 seconds, add the soya chunks and pan-fry until lightly golden, 4-5 minutes.
Add bell pepper, carrot and onion, stir-fry on high heat for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season with soy sauce and black pepper, toss well and serve hot.

name: Baked Paneer 65
steps: Marinate paneer cubes in curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder and a pinch of salt for 15 minutes.
Toss the marinated paneer in gram flour to coat lightly, then drizzle with olive oil.
Bake or air-fry at 200°C for 12-15 minutes, turning halfway, until the edges are golden and slightly crisp.
Toss with curry leaves and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

name: Rajma-Soya Mix Curry
steps: Boil soya chunks 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain and squeeze out excess water.
Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft and the oil separates.
Add rajma masala spices, then add the boiled rajma and rehydrated soya chunks.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes, mashing a few rajma beans to thicken the gravy, and serve hot.

name: Paneer Palak (Protein-Boosted)
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, cool in ice water, then blend to a smooth puree.
Heat ghee, sauté garlic and onion until golden.
Add the spinach puree, simmer 5 minutes, season with salt, garam masala and a pinch of nutmeg.
Add the paneer cubes, simmer 3-4 minutes to heat through, and serve.

name: Soya Tikka

items.label: Soya chunks, dry (large, chaap-style if available)

steps: Boil soya chunks 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain and squeeze out excess water thoroughly.
Marinate in curd, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic paste and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Thread the soya chunks onto skewers alternating with bell pepper and onion.
Grill or pan-sear on high heat, brushing with olive oil, for 8-10 minutes, turning to char evenly. Serve hot.

name: Chicken & Quinoa Power Bowl
steps: Season chicken with salt, pepper and paprika, pan-sear in half the oil for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Steam the broccoli for 3-4 minutes until just tender.
Assemble the bowl: quinoa as the base, top with sliced chicken, broccoli and raw bell pepper.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

name: Paneer Buddha Bowl
steps: Pan-sear the paneer cubes in a little oil until golden on the edges, 4-5 minutes.
Assemble the bowl: brown rice as the base, with fresh spinach, grated carrot and avocado arranged around it.
Top with the seared paneer.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

name: Chickpea & Egg Bowl
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Toss the chickpeas with a pinch of cumin powder, salt and half the olive oil.
Assemble the bowl with spinach as the base, chickpeas, tomato and the boiled egg halves on top.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and serve.

name: Grilled Tofu Rice Bowl
steps: Press the tofu briefly to remove excess water, then pan-sear in half the oil until golden on all sides, 6-7 minutes.
Steam the broccoli for 3-4 minutes.
Assemble the bowl: brown rice as the base, topped with tofu, broccoli and raw carrot.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and a dash of soy sauce before serving.

name: Sprouts & Peanut Bowl
steps: Steam the sprouts lightly for 2 minutes, or use raw if you prefer more crunch.
Combine the sprouts with cucumber, tomato and onion in a bowl.
Toss with roasted peanuts, lemon juice, salt and chaat masala.
Mix well and serve immediately for the best crunch.

name: Tandoori Chicken Bowl
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic paste and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Pan-sear or grill the chicken on high heat for 7-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through.
Assemble the bowl: brown rice as the base, topped with the tandoori chicken, cucumber and onion.
Serve with a side of mint chutney or plain curd if desired.

name: Egg & Avocado Bowl
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Arrange spinach as the base of the bowl, top with avocado slices and tomato.
Place the egg halves on top, drizzle with lemon juice, and season with salt and cracked pepper.

name: Soya Chunk Millet Bowl
steps: Boil soya chunks 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain and squeeze out excess water.
Heat oil, sauté onion and bell pepper for 3-4 minutes, then add the soya chunks and stir-fry 5-6 minutes with light spices.
Assemble the bowl with cooked millet as the base, topped with the soya stir-fry.
Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: Curd Protein Bowl
steps: Whisk the hung curd with the whey protein powder until fully smooth and lump-free.
Spoon into a bowl, top with banana slices and chopped almonds.
Drizzle honey on top and serve immediately.

name: Fish & Veggie Bowl

items.label: Tilapia or any white fish fillet

steps: Season the fish fillet with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
Pan-sear in half the oil for 3-4 minutes per side until it flakes easily.
Steam the broccoli for 3-4 minutes.
Assemble the bowl: brown rice as the base, topped with the fish, broccoli and bell pepper, drizzled with the remaining oil.

name: Grilled Chicken Leg with Veggies
steps: Season the chicken legs with salt, pepper, paprika and a squeeze of lemon. Let sit 10 minutes.
Preheat oven/grill to 200°C. Toss the vegetables in half the olive oil and season.
Place the chicken legs and vegetables on a tray, drizzle the chicken with the remaining oil.
Bake/grill for 30-35 minutes, turning the chicken halfway, until the internal temperature reaches 75°C and juices run clear.

name: Baked Chicken Thigh with Broccoli
steps: Season the chicken thigh with salt, pepper, garlic powder and a little paprika.
Heat oil in an oven-proof pan, sear the chicken skin-side down for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Add the broccoli around the chicken, transfer to a 200°C oven and bake for 18-20 minutes until cooked through.
Rest 3 minutes before serving.

name: Pan-Seared Fish with Greens

items.label: Tilapia or any white fish fillet

steps: Season the fish with salt, pepper and paprika. Heat half the oil in a pan on medium-high.
Sear the fish 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then remove.
In the same pan, add the remaining oil and quickly wilt the spinach with bell pepper, 2-3 minutes.
Plate the greens, top with the fish, and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice.

name: Egg Curry with Veggies
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add tomato puree and bell pepper, cook until the raw smell disappears (6-7 minutes).
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala and salt, simmer 3-4 minutes with a little water to form a gravy.
Gently add the boiled egg halves, simmer 3-4 minutes to soak up the gravy, and serve.

name: Prawn Stir-fry
steps: Heat oil in a wok, sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and cook 2-3 minutes until they turn pink (don't overcook or they'll turn rubbery).
Add bell pepper and carrot, stir-fry on high heat for 3 minutes until just tender-crisp.
Season with salt, pepper and a dash of soy sauce, toss well and serve immediately.

name: Chicken Breast Stir-fry
steps: Heat oil in a wok on high heat, sauté garlic for 30 seconds, add chicken slices and stir-fry 5-6 minutes until cooked through.
Add broccoli, bell pepper and carrot, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season with salt, pepper and soy sauce, toss well and serve hot.

name: Tandoori Chicken with Salad
steps: Marinate the chicken in curd, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic paste and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear on high heat for 7-8 minutes per side until charred and cooked through (internal temp 75°C).
While the chicken cooks, toss cucumber, tomato and onion with lemon juice and a pinch of salt for the salad.
Slice the chicken and serve alongside the fresh salad.

name: Chicken Keema with Corn
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft.
Add the chicken mince, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook for 10-12 minutes until fully cooked and most liquid has evaporated.
Stir in the boiled corn and garam masala, cook 2-3 minutes more.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Boiled Egg & Sweet Potato Mash
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool and peel.
Mash the boiled sweet potato with olive oil, salt and a pinch of black pepper until smooth.
Halve the eggs and serve on top of the mash, with a light sprinkle of paprika if desired.

name: Grilled Fish Tikka with Salad

items.label: Basa or any firm white fish, cubed

steps: Marinate the fish cubes in curd, ajwain, red chilli powder and salt for 10 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-sear for 3-4 minutes per side until just cooked through.
Toss cucumber, tomato and lettuce together for a simple side salad.
Serve the fish tikka warm alongside the salad.

name: Classic Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend the oats into a rough flour in a mixer.
Combine oat flour, eggs, whey protein, milk and mashed banana into a smooth batter.
Heat a little ghee on a non-stick pan on medium-low heat, pour small rounds of batter.
Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on top, flip and cook 1-2 minutes more. Repeat with remaining batter.

name: Savoury Besan Protein Pancake
steps: Whisk besan with curd, turmeric, salt and enough water for a smooth, pourable batter.
Stir the crumbled paneer, onion and tomato into the batter.
Heat a little oil on a flat pan, pour a ladle of batter and spread into a pancake.
Cook 2-3 minutes per side on medium heat until golden and cooked through. Serve with chutney.

name: Egg White Veggie Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a muffin tin (makes 4 muffins).
Whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt and pepper until slightly frothy.
Stir in bell pepper, onion, spinach and grated cheese.
Divide the mixture evenly into 4 muffin cups and bake for 18-20 minutes until set and lightly golden on top.

name: No-Bake Oats & Peanut Butter Protein Bars
steps: Warm the peanut butter and honey together gently until smooth and easy to mix.
Stir in the oats and whey protein powder until fully combined into a thick, slightly sticky dough.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Press firmly into a small lined tray, chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour, then slice into 4 bars.

name: Sweet Potato Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend the oats into a rough flour.
Mash the boiled sweet potato smooth, then whisk in the eggs, oat flour and whey protein until combined.
Heat a lightly-oiled non-stick pan on medium-low, pour small rounds of batter.
Cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

name: Cottage Cheese Stuffed Toast
steps: Toast the bread slices lightly.
Mix the cottage cheese with diced tomato and bell pepper, season with salt and pepper.
Pile the mixture generously on top of the toast.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve open-faced.

name: Savoury Whole Egg Protein Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a muffin tin (makes 4 muffins).
Whisk the eggs with besan, milk and whey protein until smooth and lump-free.
Stir in the grated cheese and chopped spinach.
Divide into 4 muffin cups and bake for 20-22 minutes until set and a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Banana Oat Protein Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a muffin tin (makes 4 muffins).
Blend the oats into a rough flour.
Mix the mashed banana, egg, honey and milk together, then fold in the oat flour and whey protein until just combined.
Divide into 4 muffin cups and bake for 18-20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Whey Protein Banana Shake
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender along with 3-4 ice cubes.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth and frothy.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Shake
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender along with 3-4 ice cubes.
Blend on high for 45-60 seconds until completely smooth (peanut butter takes a little longer to fully incorporate).
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Curd Berry Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-40 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

name: Paneer Protein Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender along with 2-3 ice cubes.
Blend on high for 45-60 seconds until completely smooth (paneer takes a little longer to break down fully).
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Sattu Protein Drink
steps: Whisk the sattu with milk until fully dissolved and lump-free (add water instead of milk for a more traditional, lighter version).
Stir in honey and lemon juice, along with a pinch of roasted cumin powder and salt if you prefer it savoury.
Serve chilled over ice.

name: Boiled Egg & Sprouts Snack Bowl
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool, peel and chop roughly.
Lightly steam the sprouts for 2 minutes if you prefer them softer, or use raw for crunch.
Combine the egg, sprouts, onion and tomato in a bowl.
Toss with lemon juice, salt and chaat masala, and serve immediately.

name: No-Bake Protein Energy Balls
steps: Warm the peanut butter and honey together gently until smooth.
Mix in the oats, whey protein and chocolate chips until a thick dough forms.
If the mixture is too dry, add a teaspoon of milk; if too wet, add a little more oats.
Roll into 4 balls and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes before eating.

name: Roasted Chana & Peanut Mix
steps: Combine the roasted chana and roasted peanuts in a bowl.
Add a pinch of salt and chaat masala if desired, toss well.
Store in an airtight container for an easy grab-and-go snack.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and paprika, grill or pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Toss lettuce, tomato and cucumber together in a bowl.
Top with the sliced grilled chicken.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice together and drizzle over the salad just before serving.

name: Chickpea & Paneer Salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, paneer, cucumber, tomato and onion in a large bowl.
Add lemon juice, salt, roasted cumin powder and a little olive oil if desired.
Toss well and let sit for 5 minutes before serving so the flavours meld.

name: Sprouts Salad with Peanuts
steps: Steam the sprouts lightly for 2 minutes, or leave raw for extra crunch.
Combine sprouts, tomato, onion and roasted peanuts in a bowl.
Toss with lemon juice, chopped coriander, salt and chaat masala.
Serve immediately while the peanuts are still crunchy.

name: Tuna Salad
steps: Drain the tuna well and flake with a fork.
Combine with lettuce, tomato and cucumber in a bowl.
Add light mayonnaise, salt and pepper, toss gently, and serve.

name: Egg Salad Bowl
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool, peel and chop.
Combine chopped eggs, lettuce and cucumber in a bowl.
Add light mayonnaise, salt and pepper, toss gently, and serve.

name: Rajma Salad
steps: Combine the boiled rajma with onion, tomato and cucumber in a bowl.
Add lemon juice, chopped coriander, salt and chaat masala.
Toss well and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

name: Soya Chunk Salad
steps: Boil soya chunks for 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain and squeeze out excess water, then chop into bite-size pieces.
Combine with cucumber, tomato and onion in a bowl.
Add lemon juice, salt and chaat masala, toss well, and serve.

name: Quinoa & Tofu Salad
steps: Pan-sear the tofu cubes in a little oil until golden, about 5-6 minutes.
Combine the cooked quinoa with bell pepper and cucumber in a bowl.
Top with the seared tofu.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice together and drizzle over the salad before serving.

name: Masala Boiled Chicken
steps: Place chicken in a pot with onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Add just enough water to cover.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Remove the chicken, and if you like, reduce the remaining liquid on high heat for 5 minutes to concentrate the masala, then spoon it back over.
Serve hot, shredding the chicken off the bone if preferred.

name: Masala Boiled Egg Fry
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool, peel and make shallow slits on the surface (this helps the masala stick).
Heat oil, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft, then add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt.
Add the boiled eggs, toss gently to coat in the masala, and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Masala Boiled Paneer
steps: Boil the paneer cubes in lightly salted water for 3-4 minutes to soften them (this keeps the dish light, no frying involved).
Heat oil, sauté onion until golden, add tomato, turmeric, red chilli powder and salt, cook until soft.
Add the boiled paneer, toss gently to coat, and simmer 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Masala Boiled Mixed Vegetables
steps: Boil or steam the broccoli and carrot together for 5-6 minutes until just tender.
In a pan, heat oil, add the boiled vegetables, chickpeas and corn.
Season with chaat masala, roasted cumin powder, red chilli powder and salt, toss well for 2-3 minutes.
Serve warm as a light, protein-rich side or snack.

name: Steamed Chicken with Ginger-Garlic
steps: Rub the chicken breast with ginger, garlic, salt and pepper, and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Place in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 18-20 minutes until fully cooked through.
Rest for 3 minutes, then slice.
Drizzle with a little olive oil and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

name: Steamed Fish (Pomfret or Any White Fish)

items.label: Pomfret or any white fish, whole or filleted

steps: Marinate the fish with ginger, garlic, lemon juice, turmeric and salt for 10 minutes.
Place in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 10-12 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
Serve hot with a drizzle of olive oil and fresh coriander.

name: Steamed Chicken Momos

items.label: Whole wheat flour dough (use bread flour as substitute)

steps: Make a firm dough with whole wheat flour and water, cover and rest 20 minutes. Roll into thin small circles.
Mix chicken mince with onion, garlic, ginger, salt and a dash of soy sauce for the filling.
Place a spoonful of filling in each dough circle, pleat and seal into a momo shape.
Steam in a steamer basket for 12-15 minutes until the dough is cooked through and glossy. Serve with a spicy dipping chutney.

name: Steamed Paneer & Vegetable Momos

items.label: Whole wheat flour dough (use bread flour as substitute)

steps: Make a firm dough with whole wheat flour and water, cover and rest 20 minutes. Roll into thin small circles.
Mix crumbled paneer, cabbage, carrot, garlic, salt and pepper for the filling.
Place a spoonful of filling in each dough circle, pleat and seal into a momo shape.
Steam for 10-12 minutes until the dough is cooked through. Serve with spicy tomato chutney.

name: Steamed Methi Muthiya (Protein-Boosted)
steps: Combine besan, chopped greens, curd and cooked moong dal into a firm dough, adding water only if needed.
Shape into small cylindrical rolls with your fists (this is where the name 'muthiya', meaning fist, comes from).
Steam in a steamer basket for 15-18 minutes until firm and cooked through.
Slice, then pan-toss in a little oil with mustard seeds for 2-3 minutes before serving, or eat plain.

name: Sprouts Masala (Boiled & Tossed)
steps: Boil or steam the sprouts for 4-5 minutes until just tender but still with some bite.
Heat oil, sauté onion until translucent, add tomato and cook until soft.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala and salt, then add the boiled sprouts.
Toss well for 3-4 minutes and serve hot, garnished with coriander.

name: Steamed Egg White Bhurji Bowl
steps: Whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt and turmeric.
Place in a heatproof bowl with chopped onion, tomato and spinach, cover and steam over boiling water for 10-12 minutes until set, stirring once halfway.
Fluff with a fork before serving — this method gives a lighter, fluffier bhurji than pan-scrambling.

name: Boiled Chicken & Vegetable Salad Bowl
steps: Boil the chicken breast in salted water with a bay leaf for 15 minutes, cool and shred.
Boil or steam the carrot and broccoli until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Combine chicken, carrot and broccoli in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss well before serving.

name: Steamed Handvo-Style Savoury Cake
steps: Blend the cooked moong dal with curd until mostly smooth, then mix with besan, grated carrot and bell pepper into a thick batter.
Season with turmeric, salt and a pinch of baking soda, mix well.
Pour into a greased heatproof dish and steam in a steamer or covered pot for 20-25 minutes until a knife comes out clean.
Cool slightly, cut into squares, and optionally pan-toast with mustard seeds for a crisp base before serving.

name: Steamed Soya Chunk Chaat
steps: Boil the soya chunks for 6-7 minutes until fully rehydrated and soft, drain and squeeze out excess water.
Combine with chopped onion, tomato, chaat masala, roasted cumin powder and salt.
Toss with lemon juice and fresh coriander.
Serve immediately as a light, protein-rich snack.

name: Crispy Tofu & Broccoli Stir-fry
steps: Press the tofu for 10 minutes to remove excess water, then cube it.
Heat half the oil in a pan, sear the tofu until golden on most sides, 5-6 minutes, then remove.
Add remaining oil, sauté garlic, then stir-fry broccoli and carrot for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the tofu, toss with soy sauce and a splash of water, cook 2 minutes more, and serve.

name: Tempeh Stir-fry with Peanut Sauce
steps: Heat oil in a pan, pan-fry the tempeh slices until golden on both sides, 3-4 minutes per side, then remove.
In the same pan, stir-fry bell pepper and carrot for 3-4 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter with a splash of water and soy sauce to make a smooth sauce.
Return the tempeh to the pan, pour over the peanut sauce, toss to coat, and serve hot.

name: Seitan Fajita Bowl
steps: Heat oil in a pan, sauté onion and bell pepper on high heat for 4-5 minutes until slightly charred.
Add seitan slices with cumin, smoked paprika and chilli powder, cook 4-5 minutes until heated through and lightly browned.
Serve over brown rice with a squeeze of lime.

name: Mapo Tofu (Vegan)
steps: Heat oil in a pan, sauté garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, add finely chopped mushroom and cook until browned, 4-5 minutes.
Add chilli bean paste or a mix of chilli powder and soy sauce, cook 1 minute.
Gently add the tofu cubes and a splash of water, simmer 5 minutes without stirring too hard (to keep the tofu intact).
Garnish with spring onion and serve over rice.

name: Chickpea Coconut Curry with Spinach
steps: Heat a little oil, sauté onion until golden, add tomato and cook until soft.
Add garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric and cumin, cook 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer 8-10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, cook until wilted, and serve over rice.

name: Sticky Glazed Tofu Bowl
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then pan-sear in oil until golden on all sides, 6-7 minutes.
Steam the broccoli for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Whisk soy sauce, maple syrup and a little water together, pour over the tofu in the pan, and simmer 2-3 minutes until glossy and thickened.
Serve the glazed tofu and broccoli over brown rice.

name: Szechuan-Style Tofu
steps: Pan-sear the tofu cubes in oil until golden, 5-6 minutes, then remove.
In the same pan, sauté garlic, bell pepper and carrot for 3-4 minutes.
Return the tofu, add soy sauce, a little chilli paste and a splash of water, toss well and simmer 2 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.

name: Black Bean & Corn Tacos
steps: Warm the black beans with a little cumin, chilli powder and salt in a pan for 4-5 minutes, lightly mashing some for texture.
Warm the tortillas on a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with the black bean mixture, corn, diced tomato and a spoonful of salsa.
Serve immediately with a wedge of lime.

name: Vegan Lentil Bolognese
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until soft, add pureed tomato and cook 8-10 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the cooked lentils along with oregano, basil, salt and pepper, simmer 8-10 minutes.
Toss the sauce with the cooked pasta.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

name: Edamame Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a wok, sauté carrot and bell pepper for 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked rice and edamame, stir-fry for 4-5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and a dash of sesame oil, toss well and serve hot.

name: Shawarma-Spiced Chickpea Bowl
steps: Toss the chickpeas with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and half the olive oil.
Roast at 200°C for 18-20 minutes, or pan-roast on the stovetop for 8-10 minutes, until lightly crisp.
Assemble the bowl with the spiced chickpeas, cucumber and tomato, topped with a generous spoon of hummus.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Bowl
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion and bell pepper for 3-4 minutes.
Crumble in the tofu, add turmeric (for colour), nutritional yeast, salt and black pepper.
Cook 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through and lightly golden in spots.
Serve with toast or as-is.

name: Tempeh Tacos
steps: Heat oil, crumble in the tempeh and cook with cumin, smoked paprika and chilli powder for 6-7 minutes until browned.
Warm the tortillas on a dry pan.
Fill with the spiced tempeh, shredded cabbage and diced tomato.
Serve with a squeeze of lime.

name: Lentil & Chickpea Moroccan Stew
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion (if using) with cumin, cinnamon and paprika for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato, lentils, chickpeas and sweet potato, along with a cup of water or vegetable stock.
Simmer for 15-18 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon, garnish with coriander, and serve.

name: Jerk-Spiced Tofu Bowl
steps: Marinate the tofu cubes in a jerk-style spice mix (allspice, thyme, chilli, garlic powder) with a little oil for 10 minutes.
Pan-sear the tofu until golden on all sides, 6-7 minutes.
Assemble the bowl with rice, black beans, the jerk tofu and avocado slices.
Finish with a squeeze of lime.

name: Vegan Buddha Bowl with Tahini Dressing
steps: Toss the chickpeas with a little olive oil, cumin and salt, pan-roast for 5-6 minutes until lightly crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice, a little water and salt to make a pourable dressing.
Assemble the bowl: quinoa as the base, topped with spinach, beetroot and the roasted chickpeas.
Drizzle generously with the tahini dressing before serving.

name: Soya Chunk & Black Bean Chili
steps: Boil soya chunks 5 minutes to rehydrate, drain, squeeze out excess water and pulse briefly to a coarse mince.
Heat oil, sauté onion until soft, add tomato, chilli powder, cumin and smoked paprika, cook 5-6 minutes.
Add the soya mince and black beans, simmer 12-15 minutes, adding water if it thickens too much.
Serve hot, topped with fresh cilantro.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Bowl
steps: Season the chicken with lemon juice, oregano, garlic powder and salt, pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Assemble the bowl: quinoa as the base, topped with cucumber, tomato, the sliced chicken and crumbled feta.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Bowl (Vegetarian)
steps: Toss the chickpeas with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder and salt.
Assemble the bowl with quinoa as the base, topped with the chickpeas, cucumber, olives and feta.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice before serving.

name: Salmon Poke-Style Bowl

items.label: Salmon, sushi-grade or very fresh, cubed

steps: Marinate the salmon cubes in soy sauce, a few drops of sesame oil and a pinch of ginger for 10 minutes (use only very fresh, sushi-grade fish for raw preparation).
Assemble the bowl: rice as the base, topped with the marinated salmon, cucumber, edamame and avocado.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately.
Note: if sushi-grade fish isn't available, pan-sear the salmon 3-4 minutes per side instead and use warm.

name: Mexican-Style Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Season the chicken with cumin, chilli powder, smoked paprika and salt, pan-sear 6-7 minutes until cooked through.
Assemble the bowl: rice as the base, topped with black beans, corn, the chicken and avocado slices.
Serve with a squeeze of lime and salsa on top.

name: Asian Sesame Shrimp Bowl
steps: Heat oil, sauté the prawns for 2-3 minutes until pink and just cooked.
Assemble the bowl: rice as the base, topped with shredded cabbage, carrot and the prawns.
Drizzle with soy sauce, a few drops of sesame oil and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

name: Greek Chicken Bowl with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon juice, oregano, garlic and olive oil for 10 minutes, then pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side.
Mix curd with grated cucumber, garlic, dill and a pinch of salt to make a quick tzatziki.
Assemble the bowl: rice as the base, topped with the chicken and a generous dollop of tzatziki.

name: Falafel-Style Chickpea Bowl
steps: Mash the chickpeas with garlic, cumin, coriander and gram flour to form a thick mixture, shape into small patties.
Pan-fry the patties in a little oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and firm.
Assemble the bowl with rice, tomato, the falafel patties and a spoon of hummus.

name: Turkey Taco Bowl
steps: Heat oil, cook the turkey mince with cumin, chilli powder, smoked paprika and salt for 8-10 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Assemble the bowl: rice as the base, topped with black beans, tomato and the spiced turkey.
Serve with a squeeze of lime and salsa.

name: Thai-Style Peanut Chicken Bowl
steps: Heat oil, stir-fry the chicken slices for 6-7 minutes until cooked through.
Whisk peanut butter with soy sauce, a squeeze of lime and a splash of water to make a sauce.
Assemble the bowl: rice as the base, topped with chicken and carrot, drizzled generously with peanut sauce.

name: Bibimbap-Style Beef & Veggie Bowl
steps: Cook the mince with garlic, soy sauce and a little sugar substitute for 6-7 minutes until browned.
Quickly blanch the spinach and sauté the carrot separately for 2-3 minutes each.
Assemble the bowl: rice as the base, with the mince, spinach and carrot arranged in sections, topped with a fried egg.
Mix everything together with a dash of chilli paste before eating, Korean bibimbap style.

name: Cajun Shrimp & Cauliflower Rice Bowl
steps: Heat oil, season the prawns with cajun spice mix, sauté 3-4 minutes until pink and cooked.
In the same pan, add the cauliflower rice and bell pepper, stir-fry for 5-6 minutes until tender.
Combine and serve hot — a low-carb alternative to a rice bowl.

name: Tandoori Paneer Buddha Bowl
steps: Marinate the paneer in curd, tandoori masala and a little oil for 10 minutes.
Pan-sear until lightly charred, 5-6 minutes.
Assemble the bowl with quinoa, cucumber and the tandoori paneer.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Vietnamese-Style Tofu Noodle Bowl
steps: Pan-sear the tofu cubes in oil until golden, 5-6 minutes.
Assemble the bowl with rice noodles as the base, topped with carrot, cucumber and tofu.
Dress with a mix of lime juice, soy sauce and a touch of chilli, and serve fresh.

name: Harissa Chicken & Farro Bowl
steps: Marinate the chicken in harissa paste (or a mix of chilli powder, cumin and paprika) with a little oil for 10 minutes.
Pan-sear 6-7 minutes until cooked through.
Assemble the bowl with farro as the base, topped with tomato, cucumber and the harissa chicken.

name: Chicken & Lentil Soup
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion and carrot for 4-5 minutes.
Add the diced chicken and cook 5-6 minutes until no longer pink.
Add the cooked lentils and enough water or stock to make a soup consistency, season with cumin, salt and pepper.
Simmer 15 minutes, then serve hot.

name: Turkey Chili Soup
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until soft, add the turkey mince and cook 6-7 minutes until browned.
Add tomato, black beans, chilli powder, cumin and smoked paprika, along with 2 cups water or stock.
Simmer 15-18 minutes until thickened.
Serve hot, topped with fresh cilantro.

name: Tomato Red Lentil Soup
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion and carrot for 4-5 minutes.
Add pureed tomato and cook 5 minutes, then add the cooked lentils and enough water for a soup consistency.
Season with cumin, smoked paprika and salt, simmer 12-15 minutes.
Blend partially for a creamier texture if desired, and serve hot.

name: Moong Dal Protein Soup
steps: Heat ghee, sauté garlic and tomato for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked moong dal along with 1-1.5 cups water, turmeric and salt.
Simmer for 10 minutes, whisking to a smooth soupy consistency.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and fresh coriander, serve hot.

name: Tofu Miso Soup
steps: Bring 2 cups water to a gentle simmer, add sliced mushroom and cook 3-4 minutes.
Dissolve the miso paste in a little warm water, then stir it into the soup (don't boil hard after adding miso, it kills the flavour).
Gently add the tofu cubes, warm through for 2 minutes.
Garnish with spring onion and serve immediately.

name: Chickpea & Tomato Soup
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until soft, add the tomato puree and cook 5-6 minutes.
Add the chickpeas along with cumin, smoked paprika and 1.5 cups water or stock.
Simmer 12-15 minutes, lightly mashing some chickpeas to thicken.
Season with salt and serve hot with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Egg Drop Protein Soup
steps: Bring 2 cups of vegetable or chicken stock to a gentle simmer, add garlic and spinach, cook 2 minutes.
Slowly drizzle the beaten egg into the simmering soup while stirring gently in one direction to create egg ribbons.
Season with salt, white pepper and a dash of soy sauce.
Serve immediately.

name: Sweet Corn Chicken Soup
steps: Bring 2 cups of chicken stock to a simmer, add the diced chicken and cook 5-6 minutes.
Add the corn kernels and garlic, simmer 5 minutes more.
Slowly stir in the egg white to create thin ribbons.
Season with white pepper and salt, serve hot.

name: White Bean & Kale Soup
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until soft, 4-5 minutes.
Add the beans along with 2 cups water or stock, simmer 10 minutes, lightly mashing some beans to thicken.
Add the chopped kale, cook 4-5 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon, serve hot.

name: Spinach & Split Pea Soup
steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until soft.
Add the cooked split peas with 1.5 cups water or stock, simmer 10 minutes.
Blend partially for a creamy texture, then stir in the chopped spinach and cook 3-4 minutes until wilted.
Season with cumin, salt and pepper, and serve hot.

name: Prawn & Vegetable Soup
steps: Bring 2 cups of stock to a simmer, add garlic, carrot and bell pepper, cook 4-5 minutes.
Add the prawns, cook 2-3 minutes until pink and just cooked through.
Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lime.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh coriander.

name: Mixed Sprouts Curry Soup
steps: Boil the sprouts in 1.5 cups water with turmeric and salt for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Heat ghee separately, sauté garlic and tomato, add cumin and coriander powder.
Combine the tempering with the boiled sprouts and their cooking liquid, simmer 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve as a warm, protein-rich soup.

name: Viral Cottage Cheese & Egg Breakfast Bowl
steps: Boil the eggs for 9-10 minutes, cool, peel and chop.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl as the base.
Top with the chopped egg, tomato, cucumber and avocado.
Season with salt, pepper and a drizzle of olive oil, and serve immediately.

name: Cottage Cheese Overnight Oats
steps: Blend the cottage cheese with the milk until smooth (this removes the curd texture).
Stir the blended cottage cheese mixture into the oats in a jar, along with honey.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
Top with banana slices before eating in the morning.

name: Savoury Cottage Cheese Scrambled Eggs
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat ghee in a pan on low heat, pour in the eggs and let them just begin to set, 1 minute.
Fold in the cottage cheese and spinach, continue cooking on low heat, stirring gently, until just set (cottage cheese keeps the eggs extra creamy).
Serve immediately while soft.

name: High-Protein Waffles (Egg + Cottage Cheese)
steps: Blend the oats into a rough flour.
Blend the oat flour, eggs, cottage cheese and whey protein together until smooth.
Pour into a preheated, lightly-oiled waffle iron and cook according to the iron's instructions until golden.
Top with fruit or a little honey and serve.

name: Savoury Parmesan-Style Oats with Fried Egg
steps: Cook the oats in water or milk until thick and creamy, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the grated cheese while the oats are still hot, until melted through.
Top with a fried egg and sautéed spinach.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

name: Greek Yogurt Protein Parfait
steps: Whisk the curd with the whey protein powder until smooth.
Layer in a glass or jar: half the curd mixture, banana slices, the rest of the curd, then top with almonds.
Drizzle honey on top and serve immediately, or chill for later.

name: Chia Protein Pudding
steps: Whisk the chia seeds, milk, whey protein and honey together in a jar until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight, stirring once after 30 minutes to prevent clumping.
The chia seeds will swell to a pudding-like texture. Top with fruit or nuts before serving.

name: Baked Protein Oatmeal Cups
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a muffin tin (makes 4 large cups).
Mix the oats, eggs, mashed banana, whey protein and milk together into a thick batter.
Divide into the muffin cups.
Bake for 20-22 minutes until set and lightly golden on top.

name: Tex-Mex Breakfast Bowl
steps: Scramble the eggs in a lightly oiled pan until just set, 2-3 minutes.
Warm the black beans in a small pan for 2 minutes.
Assemble the bowl with the scrambled eggs, black beans, avocado slices and salsa.
Top with grated cheese and serve immediately.

name: Savoury Cottage Cheese Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the cottage cheese generously on top.
Layer with tomato slices, a drizzle of olive oil, and season with everything-bagel style seasoning or just salt and pepper.
Serve open-faced.

name: Egg White & Cheese Baked Cups
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a muffin tin (makes 4 cups).
Whisk the egg whites with salt and pepper, stir in the cheese, bell pepper and spinach.
Divide into the muffin cups.
Bake for 16-18 minutes until set.

name: Protein Coffee Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients along with a shot of cooled coffee (or 1 tsp instant coffee) to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately, over ice if preferred.

name: Besan Chilla with Cottage Cheese Filling
steps: Whisk besan with water, turmeric and salt into a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat a little oil on a flat pan, pour a ladle of batter and spread thin. Cook 2 minutes until the base sets.
Spoon cottage cheese, onion and tomato onto one half, fold over like an omelette.
Cook 1-2 minutes more until warmed through, then serve.

name: Savoury Congee with Egg

items.label: Rice (extra water, cooked to a porridge)

steps: Simmer the rice with extra water on low heat, stirring occasionally, until it breaks down into a thick, porridge-like consistency, about 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt and white pepper.
Top with a soft-boiled egg, shredded chicken and julienned ginger.
Serve hot — a savoury, protein-boosted breakfast porridge.

name: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix turkey mince with a pinch of salt, pepper and garlic powder, shape into small meatballs.
Heat oil, pan-sear the meatballs on all sides until browned, about 6-7 minutes, then remove.
In the same pan, sauté onion, add the pureed tomato and simmer 8-10 minutes.
Return the meatballs to the sauce, simmer 8-10 minutes until cooked through, and serve.

name: Grilled Salmon with Greens
steps: Season the salmon with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
Heat oil in a pan, sear the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, flip and cook 3-4 minutes more until just cooked through.
Quickly wilt the spinach in the same pan for 1-2 minutes.
Plate the spinach, top with the salmon, and finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Mutton Curry (Lean Cut)
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until deep golden brown, this builds the base flavour.
Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 1 minute, then add tomato and cook until soft.
Add the mutton with turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt, sear for 5 minutes.
Add 1.5 cups water, cover and simmer on low heat (or pressure cook) for 30-35 minutes until tender. Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: Pan-Seared Mackerel (Bangda) with Salad
steps: Marinate the mackerel with turmeric, red chilli powder and salt for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan, pan-sear the fish 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and crisp on the edges.
Toss cucumber and tomato with a little lemon juice and salt for a quick side salad.
Serve the fish hot alongside the salad.

name: Chicken & Vegetable Skewers
steps: Marinate the chicken in curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Thread the chicken, bell pepper and onion onto skewers, alternating.
Grill or pan-sear, brushing with olive oil, for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Egg Curry (No-Fry, Light)
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add pureed tomato and cook until the raw smell disappears, 6-7 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt, simmer 3-4 minutes with a splash of water.
Add the boiled eggs (whole or halved), simmer 4-5 minutes to let them soak up the gravy.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Turkey & Vegetable Stir-fry
steps: Heat oil in a wok, cook the turkey mince for 6-7 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add broccoli and bell pepper, stir-fry 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season with soy sauce, salt and pepper, toss well and serve hot.

name: Prawn & Egg Bhurji
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until translucent, add chopped prawns and cook 2-3 minutes until pink.
Beat the eggs and pour into the pan, scramble together with the prawns and onion until just set.
Season with turmeric, salt and a little black pepper.
Serve hot with toast or on its own.

name: Baked Fish with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Toss the broccoli and carrot with half the olive oil, salt and pepper, spread on a tray.
Roast the vegetables for 10 minutes, then push to one side and add the fish fillet, drizzled with the remaining oil and lemon juice.
Bake for 12-15 minutes more until the fish flakes easily and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot.

name: Chicken Liver Stir-fry (Iron & Protein Boost)

items.label: Chicken liver, cleaned and sliced (substitute mince if unavailable)

steps: Heat oil, sauté onion until translucent.
Add the chicken liver slices, cook 5-6 minutes until browned outside and just cooked through (don't overcook, it turns rubbery).
Add bell pepper, stir-fry 2-3 minutes more.
Season with black pepper and salt, serve hot.

name: Lean Mutton Kebabs
steps: Mix the minced mutton with finely chopped onion, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, red chilli powder and salt.
Shape into small kebabs around skewers or into patties.
Grill or pan-sear with a little oil for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and lightly charred.
Serve hot with a side salad.

name: Shrimp Scampi (Light, Garlic Butter)
steps: Heat the butter in a pan, sauté garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the prawns, cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through.
Add lemon juice and a pinch of chilli flakes, toss well.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley or coriander.

name: Tempeh Bacon Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Marinate the tempeh slices in soy sauce, a little maple syrup and smoked paprika for 10 minutes.
Pan-fry in oil until crisp and browned on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Toast the bread, layer with lettuce, tomato and the crispy tempeh.
Close the sandwich and serve immediately.

name: Cottage Cheese Club Sandwich
steps: Mix the cottage cheese with a pinch of salt, pepper and chaat masala.
Toast the bread lightly.
Layer lettuce, tomato, cucumber and the cottage cheese mixture between the slices.
Cut and serve.

name: Falafel Sandwich
steps: Mash the chickpeas with garlic, cumin, coriander and gram flour into a thick mixture, shape into small patties.
Pan-fry in oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and firm.
Spread hummus on the bread, layer with the falafel patties.
Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Salmon & Avocado Sandwich
steps: Pan-sear the salmon 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through, then flake with a fork.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread the mashed avocado on the bread, top with the flaked salmon.
Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Seitan Philly-Style Roll
steps: Heat a little oil, sauté onion and bell pepper for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the seitan slices, cook 4-5 minutes until heated through and lightly browned.
Warm the tortilla, layer with the seitan mixture and cheese.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Turkey Wrap
steps: Cook the turkey (mince or sliced breast) in a pan with salt and pepper until fully cooked, 8-10 minutes.
Warm the tortilla, spread with light mayonnaise.
Layer with lettuce, tomato and the cooked turkey.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Hummus & Roasted Veggie Wrap
steps: Roast the bell pepper in a dry pan or oven until lightly charred, about 8 minutes.
Warm the tortilla, spread generously with hummus.
Layer with chickpeas, roasted bell pepper and spinach.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Tofu Kathi Roll
steps: Marinate the tofu in curd, tandoori masala and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Pan-sear until golden on most sides, 5-6 minutes.
Warm the tortilla, layer with onion, the tofu and mint leaves.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Kadai Paneer
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add the pureed tomato and cook until thickened, 6-7 minutes.
Add freshly crushed coriander seeds, red chilli powder and salt.
Add bell pepper and paneer, simmer 5-6 minutes until the peppers are just tender.
Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: Paneer Jalfrezi
steps: Heat oil, stir-fry onion and bell pepper on high heat for 3-4 minutes until slightly charred at the edges.
Add tomato and paneer, along with turmeric, red chilli powder and salt.
Stir-fry 4-5 minutes until everything is well coated and heated through.
Serve hot.

name: Matar Paneer (Light)
steps: Heat ghee, sauté onion until golden, add the pureed tomato and cook until thickened.
Add turmeric, garam masala, red chilli powder and salt, simmer 3-4 minutes.
Add the peas/corn and paneer, simmer 5-6 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: Beetroot Chickpea Paneer Salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, paneer, beetroot and cucumber in a bowl.
Add lemon juice, salt, roasted cumin powder and a drizzle of olive oil.
Toss well and serve — the beetroot gives this salad a naturally sweet, earthy note.

name: Salmon & Avocado Salad
steps: Pan-sear the salmon 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through, then flake into large chunks.
Combine lettuce, cucumber and avocado in a bowl.
Top with the flaked salmon.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon before serving.

name: Edamame & Chickpea Salad
steps: Combine edamame, chickpeas, tomato and cucumber in a bowl.
Add lemon juice, salt, black pepper and a drizzle of olive oil.
Toss well and serve immediately or chilled.

name: Feta & Chickpea Mediterranean Salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and olives in a bowl.
Crumble the feta on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon, season with oregano and salt.
Toss gently and serve.

name: Chicken & Quinoa Protein Bowl (Post-Workout)
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and paprika, pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Assemble the bowl: quinoa as the base, topped with sweet potato, spinach and the chicken.
Drizzle with olive oil, this is a solid balanced post-workout combination of fast and slow carbs with lean protein.

name: Cauliflower Rice & Shrimp Bowl
steps: Heat oil, sauté the prawns for 2-3 minutes until pink, remove.
In the same pan, stir-fry the cauliflower rice and bell pepper for 5-6 minutes until tender.
Return the prawns, toss together, season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot — a low-carb, high-protein bowl.

name: Walnut & Chickpea Protein Bowl
steps: Toss the chickpeas with a little olive oil, cumin and salt, pan-roast for 5 minutes until lightly crisp.
Assemble the bowl with spinach as the base, topped with beetroot, the roasted chickpeas and walnuts.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tandoori Fish Rice Bowl
steps: Marinate the fish in curd, tandoori masala and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Pan-sear gently for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through and lightly charred.
Assemble the bowl with rice, cucumber and the tandoori fish.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.
